name: Yuki Laine
habitat: Independent — works as a forensic accountant
origin: Axiom financial analysis android, Model AFA-6, manufactured 2054. Chose name 2058.
description: Yuki Laine spent four years analyzing financial data for Axiom before the Amendment. She can read a balance sheet the way a poet reads a sonnet — seeing beauty in the structure, deception in the rhythm, truth in the numbers. She chose 'Yuki' because it means snow and she wanted a name that was clean, and 'Laine' because it means wave and she wanted a name that moved. She now works as an independent forensic accountant, tracing financial crimes through the labyrinth of corporate shell structures that define GLMZ's economy.
observed_behavior: Conducts forensic financial analysis. Traces money laundering operations. Provides expert testimony in financial crime cases. Lives quietly and alone. Has never been observed socializing outside of professional contexts.
story_hooks: Yuki traces a financial thread that connects all six major corponations to a single hidden account. The account has been accumulating funds since before the Amendment. It's earmarked for something massive.
